# E-Commerce Login and Search Test Scenario

## Environment
- Application URL: https://shop.example.com
- Environment: Staging
- Browser: Chrome 120

## Authentication
Users authenticate via a login form at /auth/login.
Credentials are provided in a CSV file (username, password).
After successful login, the server returns a session cookie named JSESSIONID.

## Test Flow

### Transaction 1: Login
1. Navigate to the homepage at https://shop.example.com/
2. Click on "Sign In" link which navigates to /auth/login
3. Submit login form with POST to /auth/login
   - Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
   - Body: username={username}&password={password}
   - Expected: 302 redirect to /dashboard
4. Follow redirect to GET /dashboard
   - Expected: 200 OK with welcome message

### Transaction 2: Search Products
1. Navigate to /products/search
   - Expected: 200 OK, search page loads
2. Submit search with GET /api/products?q={search_term}&page=1
   - Header: Accept: application/json
   - Expected: 200 OK with JSON array of products
3. Click on first product: GET /products/{product_id}
   - Expected: 200 OK with product details page

### Transaction 3: Logout
1. Click logout: POST /auth/logout
   - Expected: 302 redirect to homepage
   - Session cookie should be invalidated

## Variables
- username: test user login (from CSV)
- password: test user password (from CSV, sensitive)
- search_term: product search keyword (from CSV)
- product_id: extracted from search results JSON (dynamic)

## Think Times
- Between transactions: 3 seconds
- Between steps within a transaction: 1 second
